definitions.explanation: The final part or extremity of something.
What will happen eventually; the outcome after a process.
The final part of a time period (month, year, etc.).

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末|すえ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}して→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please submit it by the end of next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末|すえ}、⟦{結論|けつろん}→結論：02704_ketsuron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: After a long discussion, a conclusion was reached.

examples.english: The youngest child is doted on by the whole family.
